summary_en: 35,000,000 shares (1.4% of ex-treasury S/O) up to ¥200.0B (¥100.0B added). Execution window extended from 2026/08/31 to 2026/09/30. Market purchase via trust. Cancellation rescheduled from 2026/09/24 to 2026/10/23. Framework decision of 2026/05/15 expanded; rationale: optimal balance of capital adequacy, growth investment, and enhanced shareholder returns with total payout ≥50%.
title_en: Notice regarding partial amendment to the notice of determination of matters related to treasury stock acquisition and treasury stock cancellation
translation_en_brief: On 30 July 2026, Mizuho Financial Group announced an expansion and extension of its treasury stock acquisition program previously authorized on 15 May 2026. The board resolved to increase the buyback authorization from 25.0M shares (¥100.0B ceiling) to 35.0M shares (¥200.0B ceiling), representing 1.4% of ex-treasury shares outstanding as of 30 June 2026. The acquisition window is extended from the original 18 May–31 August 2026 to 18 May–30 September 2026. All shares acquired will be cancelled; the cancellation date is pushed from 24 September 2026 to 23 October 2026. The company will execute purchases via market transactions through a trust arrangement. The expansion reflects the company's shareholder return policy of progressive dividend increases and opportunistic buybacks, with total cash return targeting a payout ratio of 50% or above, balanced against capital adequacy needs and growth investment opportunities. The company notes that the final cancellation share count will be announced after acquisition completion.
